name: Quevedo
bio: Quevedo is a Spanish singer and rapper from the Canary Islands known for blending melodic hooks with reggaeton rhythms and Latin trap production. He built an early following independently before a widely viewed collaborative freestyle session helped push him to international attention. His music tends toward moody, introspective lyrics set against polished, radio-ready production, and he has since become one of the leading voices in contemporary Spanish-language urban music.

name: Bad Bunny
bio: Bad Bunny is a Puerto Rican rapper and singer widely regarded as one of the artists most responsible for bringing reggaeton and Latin trap into the global mainstream. He first gained attention posting music online before rapidly rising to international stardom, blending traditional Latin rhythms with trap, rock, and pop influences across his releases. He has become one of the most streamed artists in the world and is known for using his platform to speak on social and political issues affecting Puerto Rico.

name: John Summit
bio: John Summit is an American DJ and producer who has become one of the most prominent names in modern house music. His tracks typically pair soulful, often sample-based vocal hooks with driving, rolling basslines, and he has built a large following through both his studio releases and high-energy live sets. He also runs a long-running radio show and label imprint that showcases his own music alongside work from emerging house producers.

name: Calvin Harris
bio: Calvin Harris is a Scottish DJ, producer, and songwriter who has spent over a decade among the most successful names in electronic dance music. He first broke through writing and producing his own vocal tracks before shifting toward high-profile collaborations with major pop and R&B artists. His catalog spans festival-ready EDM anthems and radio-friendly dance-pop, and he has written or produced number-one hits for numerous other artists in addition to his own.

name: Ed Sheeran
bio: Ed Sheeran is an English singer-songwriter who built his early career as a solo acoustic performer before becoming one of the best-selling music artists in the world. His songwriting blends folk and pop influences with elements of hip-hop, often centered on personal storytelling and relationships. Several of his singles rank among the most streamed songs ever released, and he has also written songs recorded by numerous other major artists.

name: The Weeknd
bio: The Weeknd is a Canadian singer, songwriter, and producer known for atmospheric R&B that draws on synth-pop and new wave influences. He first gained attention through a run of moody, lo-fi mixtapes released anonymously online before evolving into one of the biggest pop stars of his generation. His music often explores nightlife, fame, and emotional isolation, delivered through a distinctive falsetto vocal style.

name: Taylor Swift
bio: Taylor Swift is an American singer-songwriter who began her career in country music before evolving into one of the most successful pop artists of all time. Her songwriting is known for detailed, narrative lyrics that often draw on her own life experiences. Over the course of her career she has moved fluidly between country, pop, indie folk, and alternative styles, and she has become known for re-recording her early albums to regain ownership of her masters.

name: Drake
bio: Drake is a Canadian rapper, singer, and songwriter known for blending hip-hop with melodic R&B in a style that has become one of the most influential sounds in modern popular music. He got his start as an actor before transitioning to music, and his catalog spans introspective, emotionally driven tracks alongside high-energy hip-hop singles. He has released a large volume of chart-topping music over his career and is regarded as one of the most commercially successful recording artists of his generation.

name: Kendrick Lamar
bio: Kendrick Lamar is an American rapper and songwriter widely regarded as one of the most acclaimed lyricists of his generation. His albums often function as cohesive narrative and conceptual works, touching on themes of race, faith, community, and his own upbringing in Compton, California. His work has earned him a Pulitzer Prize as well as numerous Grammy Awards, reflecting his standing as both a commercial and critical force in music.

name: Billie Eilish
bio: Billie Eilish is an American singer and songwriter known for her whispery vocal style set against minimalist, bass-heavy production. She first gained attention as a teenager releasing music independently with her brother, who remains her primary collaborator and producer. Her songs often explore anxiety, identity, and darker emotional territory, delivered in a way that helped define a distinct alternative-pop sound for a new generation of listeners.

name: Morgan Wallen
bio: Morgan Wallen is an American country singer known for blending traditional country songwriting with elements of hip-hop and rock. He first gained wider recognition as a contestant on a televised singing competition before building a career as one of the best-selling country artists of recent years. His music often centers on heartbreak, small-town life, and rural identity, delivered with a rougher, more contemporary edge than much of mainstream country radio.

name: BTS
bio: BTS is a South Korean group whose members write, produce, and perform much of their own material across a wide range of genres, from hip-hop to pop and R&B. Known for elaborate choreography and tightly coordinated live performances, the group built an enormous global fanbase largely through direct social media engagement before becoming one of the best-selling music acts in the world. Their lyrics frequently address mental health, self-acceptance, and the pressures of youth.

name: Metallica
bio: Metallica is an American heavy metal band formed in the early 1980s that became one of the defining acts of the thrash metal movement. Known for fast, aggressive guitar riffs paired with intricate arrangements, the band helped bring heavy metal into the mainstream over a career spanning more than four decades. They remain one of the best-selling bands in any genre and continue to headline major festivals and stadium tours worldwide.

name: Karol G
bio: Karol G is a Colombian singer known for her work in reggaeton and Latin pop, genres historically dominated by male artists. Her music combines melodic pop songwriting with urban rhythms, and her lyrics often center on female empowerment and independence. She has become one of the most successful Latin artists in the world, headlining major stadium tours and collaborating widely across the reggaeton and Latin pop scenes.

name: Dua Lipa
bio: Dua Lipa is an English singer known for dance-pop music heavily influenced by disco and 1980s pop production. She first gained attention through early singles and collaborations before releasing albums that leaned further into retro-inspired, club-ready sounds. Her music has helped drive a broader resurgence of disco influence in mainstream pop, and she has become one of the leading pop artists of her generation both commercially and critically.

name: Peso Pluma
bio: Peso Pluma is a Mexican singer who became one of the leading voices in corridos tumbados, a genre blending traditional Mexican regional music with trap and hip-hop production. His rise helped bring regional Mexican music to a much larger international and English-language audience than it had previously reached. His songs often draw on classic corrido storytelling traditions while presenting them with distinctly modern production and delivery.

name: SZA
bio: SZA is an American singer known for genre-blending R&B that incorporates elements of neo-soul, alternative, and pop. Her songwriting is often conversational and introspective, exploring insecurity, relationships, and self-discovery with unusually candid detail. After years of independent releases, her major-label debut album established her as one of the most acclaimed R&B artists of her generation, and her subsequent work has continued to top charts and earn major industry recognition.

name: Zach Bryan
bio: Zach Bryan is an American singer-songwriter known for raw, folk-leaning country music that emphasizes plainspoken storytelling over polished production. He built his early following by self-releasing music recorded largely on his own while serving in the United States Navy, developing a devoted fanbase before signing to a major label. His songs often deal with heartbreak, service, and rural American life, delivered in a stripped-down style that stands apart from mainstream country radio production.
